tenderSchedule.title: Rewinding/servicing of 320kVA DG set Alternator at Supa Power House
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer O and M Office KVP Supa

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The bidder must have successfully completed repair/rewinding/re-insulation alternators of 320 KVA or higher capacity in preceding last five years. (i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof of this, bidder should submit copy of single work/ purchase order of value not less than Rs. 2.09 lakhs (Exclusive of GST) in any reputed Industry/PSU/Government organization and corresponding satisfactory performance/work done certificate issued by competent authority (in case of state/central Government/Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre and in case of KPCL not below the rank of Chief Engineer) shall be furnished (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous work/purchase orders to bring the current price level)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work/Purchase order and Corresponding work done/Performance certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover Rs. 4.17 lakh (Exclusive of GST) in the last five financial years i.e., (i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof of this Turnover Certificate duly certified by Charted Accountant shall be furnished. (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous annual turnover to bring the current price level)
